extracted.name: Easy Nacho Dip
extracted.description: This dip is great with nacho chips, and you can make it hotter or milder depending on the type of salsa you use.
instruction_lines: Combine the softened cream cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning on a large plate or in a pie plate. Spread the salsa on top of the cream cheese-sour cream mixture. Top with lettuce and cheddar cheese.
